newsitem.title: USA: Sierra Semiconductor buys Bit assets.
newsitem.headline: Sierra Semiconductor buys Bit assets.

text.p: Sierra Semiconductor Corp said it had bought the ethernet switching assets, along with other intellectual property and assets, of Bit Inc for about 900,000 shares of Sierra Semiconductor common stock.
The company said in a statement late on Thursday that in conjunction with the purchase, the employees of Bit have joined PMC-Sierra Inc, a wholly owned Sierra Semiconductor subsidiary.
Sierra common stock closed at $10 a share on Thursday on the Nasdaq exchange.

Steve Hubbard, Bit president, will become vice president of the new Ethernet Switching Products group at PMC-Sierra. Ethernet switching and other networking products will be designed and marketed at the new PMC-Sierra, Portland, Ore.

Sierra will account for the transaction as a purchase in the third quarter of 1996. The company's results of operations for the third quarter of 1996 will include the costs of the people and other operating costs from the acquisition date through Sept 30, 1996.
Accordingly, the company will record a one-time charge in the quarter for in-process research and development as part of the purchase price allocation.
